name: limit-nesting-depth-over-limit
description: A definition nested one level past the maximum depth of 5 -- an array nested inside a slot's set refs array, reaching depth 6 -- is refused before schema validation ever inspects the wrongly-typed member.
notes: The nested array is also the wrong member type for refs (an array of arrays where an array of strings belongs), which would ordinarily be a schema_violation. Because the nesting-depth check runs at the strict parse stage, before schema validation, the input is refused as input_limit_exceeded instead -- the parser never gets far enough to type-check the member. input_bytes is used rather than input because the point under test is strict-parse-stage behaviour on raw text.
